segments.text: Lesson 4
segments.translation: 第4课

segments.text: Seeing hands
segments.translation: 见手

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: How did Vera disover she had this gift of second sight?
segments.translation: 薇拉是如何发现她有复视的天赋的？

segments.text: Several cases have been reported in Russia recently of people who can read and detect colours with their fingers, and even see through solid doors and walls.
segments.translation: 最近，俄罗斯报道了几起案例，人们可以用手指阅读和检测颜色，甚至可以透过坚固的门和墙壁看到东西。

segments.text: One case concerns an 11-year-old schoolgirl Vera Petrova,
segments.translation: 其中一个案例涉及一名 11 岁女学生维拉·佩特洛娃 (Vera Petrova)，

segments.text: who has normal vision but who can also perceive things with different parts of her skin, and through solid walls.
segments.translation: 她有正常的视力，但也能用皮肤的不同部分以及透过坚固的墙壁感知事物。

segments.text: This ability was first noticed by her father.
segments.translation: 这种能力首先被她的父亲注意到。

segments.text: One day she came into his office and happened to put her hands on the door of a locked safe.
segments.translation: 有一天，她走进他的办公室，碰巧把手放在了锁着的保险箱的门上。

segments.text: Suddenly she asked her father why he kept so many old newspapers locked away there,
segments.translation: 突然她问父亲为什么要把这么多旧报纸锁在那里，

segments.text: and even described the way they were done up in bundles.
segments.translation: 甚至还描述了它们是如何捆扎起来的。

segments.text: Vera's curious talent was brought to the notice of a scientific research institute in the town of Ulyanovsk, near where she lives,
segments.translation: 薇拉的好奇天赋引起了她居住地附近乌里扬诺夫斯克镇一家科学研究所的注意，

segments.text: and in April she was given a series of tests by a special commission of the Ministry of Health of the Russian Federal Republic.
segments.translation: 4月，俄罗斯联邦共和国卫生部的一个特别委员会对她进行了一系列检查。

segments.text: During these tests she was able to read a newspaper through an opaque screen and, stranger still,
segments.translation: 在这些测试中，她能够通过不透明的屏幕阅读报纸，而且更奇怪的是，

segments.text: by moving her elbow over a child's game of Lotto she was able to describe the figures and colours printed on it;
segments.translation: 通过将她的肘部移到儿童的乐透游戏上，她能够描述上面印着的数字和颜色；

segments.text: and, in another instance, wearing stockings and slippers,
segments.translation: 在另一个例子中，穿着丝袜和拖鞋，

segments.text: to make out with her foot the outlines and colours of a picture hidden under a carpet.
segments.translation: 用她的脚辨认出隐藏在地毯下的图画的轮廓和颜色。

segments.text: Other experiments showed that her knees and shoulders had a similar sensitivity.
segments.translation: 其他实验表明她的膝盖和肩膀也有类似的敏感性。

segments.text: During all these tests Vera was blindfold; and indeed, except when blindfold she lacked the ability to perceive things with her skin.
segments.translation: 在所有这些测试中，维拉都被蒙住眼睛。

segments.text: It was also found that although she could perceive things with her fingers this ability ceased the moment her hands were wet.
segments.translation: 研究还发现，尽管她可以用手指感知事物，但一旦手湿了，这种能力就消失了。
